digest.component_or_area: create coordination and outbound dispatch routing
propositions: Process restart must not create duplicate Jira issues; coordinated create family must survive Cloud/DC crash-restart sequences with exactly one remote issue and one confirmed binding per ticket.

Single selector create_route() governs all live outbound create dispatch paths (route_for, reroute_migrated_plans, handle_create) to ensure exactly one create route is used, never both coordinator and legacy simultaneously.
Keyed recovery performs zero search and keyless recovery requires both three misses and 3600 seconds timeout; per-entry recovery failure must not block unrelated tickets.
Links and children must not release until create and binding confirmation are proven; tombstones, filters, and read-only modes remain effective during holds.

Create dispatch middle core selection (coordinated vs legacy) occurs once in handle_create and is passed to create_one; shared prelude/postlude logic and exception handling must maintain parity with legacy implementation.
Live batch and typed outbound-create paths must share one coordinated facade implementation with no dual-send and no parity drift.
